QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Floating Island of Chryse
QuestInfo.0:
High above the skies of Orbis, on the floating island of Chryse, a race of giants faces an evil too big, even for them. Xer, Michaela's sweet little pet mountain goat, has been enchanted by something evil, and it must be stopped.\r\n\r\n

- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 50-70\r\n
- #eRoute#n: Orbis Park\r\n
- #eFinal Reward#n: \r\n
